sources.title: 北海道大学附属図書館：学外利用者の現物借用・文献複写条件及び本館貴重資料室の除外規定
sources.provider: Hokkaido University Library (first-party current public policy)
sources.quality_notes: The official ILL page directs external individuals through a university/local public library, excludes rare books from interlibrary lending, excludes main-library rare-materials-room holdings and laboratory holdings from ordinary document copying, and lists normal copy tariff 50 JPY monochrome/100 JPY color per sheet plus postage only for eligible materials. BB10385966 physical fascicle 0181427762 has NOT been independently classified as being in that specific rare-materials room; no waiver, copy approval, surcharge, price quote, remote scan, item original target leaf or rights to republish follows from this generic policy. The public external contact form is expressly limited to holdings, bibliography and access/how-to questions; no inquiry has been submitted.
